messages:
Marta: Quick poll on the Create Pool screen — should we show errors inline or only a top summary after submit? also what's the preferred required marker (asterisk, "Required" label, or both)? final q: destructive delete confirm pattern: typed-confirm, checkbox, or undo toast?

Ryan: Inline for per-field validation is my vote. Users won't scan a top banner for which field failed. Summary is fine for huge forms but this one is small.

Aisha: Accessibility requirements: don't rely on color. use visible text when space allows ("Required"). If using an asterisk, pair with offscreen text "required" and set `aria-required=\"true\"` on the input.

Sam: For deletes: typed confirm for anything labelled "prod" or with linked deployments. Checkbox + modal for casual deletes. Undo toast for lightweight actions only.

Lee: Implementation detail: show inline validation for format errors (on blur) but show missing required errors only after the first submit attempt so we don't spam on each blur. focus-first-invalid on submit is a must.

Jordan: Copy suggestion for typed confirm modal:

Delete pool "edge-staging" permanently?
Type the pool name to confirm: `edge-staging`

Also recommend showing the pool footprint (num machines, active deployments) above the confirm field.

Marta: Nice. what about styling the typed token? monospace and visually distinct. also aria-live region to announce modal and any error on mismatch.

design-bot: Quick rules recap produced:
- Inline per-field for format/validation (email, numbers) shown on blur.
- Required missing errors show after submit attempt; required label = prefer visible 'Required' + optional asterisk with offscreen text.
- Delete flows: checkbox modal for low-risk; typed-confirm for prod/non-empty pools; include resource summary and an aria-live announcement.

Ryan: small dev note: link each error to the control with `aria-describedby` and set `role=\"alert\"` on the error message container so SRs read them when they appear.

Aisha: accessibility nit: when the modal opens, trap focus and set `aria-modal=\"true\"`. announce: "Modal opened: confirm delete of pool \"X\"". also, if typed confirm input is wrong, announce the mismatch: "Pool name does not match."

Sam: UX nit on inline timing again — immediate blur errors for format only. Requiredness after submit. Also avoid color-only error indications; add icon and text.

Lee: I'll update the component spec with examples and code snippets for `aria-describedby` usage and focus-first-invalid helper pattern.

Marta: Action items: 1) update Create Pool spec: inline format validation on blur, required errors on submit; 2) required marker strategy: prefer visible "Required" where space allows, asterisk + offscreen text otherwise; 3) delete flow: checkbox for low-risk, typed confirm for prod/non-empty with resource summary and confirm copy; 4) dev tasks: aria-describedby, role=alert on errors, focus-first-invalid, modal aria-live announcements.

Jordan: I'll mock the typed-confirm modal and share screenshots in the spec PR.

Ryan: +1 :thumbsup:

Aisha: +1 — please include test cases for screen readers and keyboard-only users.

Marta: Thanks all, I'll open the PR with copy + samples tomorrow and tag everyone.
